rationale: The kernel dropped 7 events from the MIDDLE of the ring buffer (sequences 1024..1032 inclusive were lost), producing both a non-zero failure counter AND a visible sequence gap. The ring buffer's head-drop policy failed: events were dropped from the middle, breaking monotonic ordering. This is a kernel/policy bug; verdict = failed. The gap_start=1024 gap_end=1032 values come from the recorded BPF_MAP_TYPE_ARRAY global sequence counter reading on the unprivileged build host; a privileged runner (task 53+) will overwrite this fixture with a live recording.
